annotations.text:
DIRECTION — the meter

Bleed measures money leaving at a rate, so the interface is an instrument: mono for every number and label, hairlines instead of shadows, 2px corners, one pine accent.

LIVE ON THIS PAGE

· Dashboard — the currency switch slides, the sort control actually re-sorts, ledger rows unfold in place, and a ruler marker selects its matching row.

· Edit panel — chips, switches, the locked last channel, and the two-step delete.

· Settings — toggles, the travelling nav rule, and the delete confirmation.

PLACEHOLDERS ON THE LANDING PAGE

Everything dashed and rust-coloured is a gap I could not fill honestly:

· Pricing — no real figure exists yet.
· Social proof — better absent than invented.
· Data retention — must come from your actual policy.
· The blended multi-currency total needs an FX source.

The copy elsewhere is drafted from how the product actually behaves, so read it as a proposal rather than final wording.

The sign-in screen's mode switch is live.
